rows.summary: The first phase-skill metadata regeneration used the host CP1252 default and failed while reading a UTF-8 Māori boundary before completing the first package.
Method Flow validated the ledger but its summary command failed while printing Māori text through the host CP1252 stdout encoding.
The first detailed successor selection ran 99 tests and retained one failure because the current-worktree x1 test incorrectly expected x2 artifacts to remain absent after x2 began.
